title: Meet the Winner: Creator's contest 2025 Vol.1 - Seifuku Decoded (Community's Choice, Dollfication)
content:
## _Fashion doll designer and fashion design student_[** _Dollfication_**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/387727/collection/collections) _captured the community’s heart with her pastel-toned reinterpretation of late '90s Gyaru style, earning her the_** _Community Choice Award_** _in the Marvelous Designer Creator’s Contest 2025. Step into the bold, adorable world of_[** _Dollfication_**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/387727/collection/collections) _💖✨_

![bede2f3df6794fc2a130512b4d1262b5](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/2983c95760f941d7a11113b5305f38ed/images/bede2f3df6794fc2a130512b4d1262b5%E1%84%80%E1%85%B3%E1%84%85%E1%85%B5%E1%86%B75.jpg)

# **Artist Introduction: please tell us about yourself.**

Hello Hello, I go online by Dollfication, I am a Fashion design student in my last semester and a full-time freelancer specifically as a fashion doll designer. My main motivation to join this contest was because the theme interested me but also because I have been having fascination with Japanese fashion and street style since decades. I even created in my second semester a winter Kogal inspired collection. So, it all seemed like the perfect time and the perfect place to be a destiny if you will and therefore, I had to participate in this contest.

# **We’d like to hear more about the art direction in your Creator’s contest 2025 Vol.1 Seifuku Decoded Contest. What was the visual style you were aiming for?**

The main visual style that I was aiming for was a classic early late 90’s/00’s kogal Gyaru look with a pastel themed color palette I also wanted the overall look and fantasy to be very cute and doll-like even cartoonish. Animes like “My Dress-Up Darling” or “SuperGals” were definitely also a huge inspiration for the overall look.

# **Would you be able to give us a quick overview of the different tools you use in your pipeline with a focus on Marvelous Designer? Have you encountered any challenges and how have you overcome them?**

The base avatar that I used was a CLO “Jinny” avatar however I did modified it in some way or another buy giving it a different more tanned skin tone compared to the original pale skin tone and changing the eye color as well as completely changing the makeup look overall to a more Gyaru late 90’s/early 00’s makeup. The Outfit was created using both mix of CLO and Marvelous Designer. I also created a custom repeat pattern for the skirt and bow using procreate and photoshop.

![4bc56fa5c4094829b45e1d4c07162b63](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/2983c95760f941d7a11113b5305f38ed/images/4bc56fa5c4094829b45e1d4c07162b63%E1%84%80%E1%85%B3%E1%84%85%E1%85%B5%E1%86%B71.jpg)![c0ff4aa9ad3d48b58e0ef8444c8c0ba0](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/2983c95760f941d7a11113b5305f38ed/images/c0ff4aa9ad3d48b58e0ef8444c8c0ba0%E1%84%80%E1%85%B3%E1%84%85%E1%85%B5%E1%86%B72.jpg)

# **Are there any tips and tricks with Marvelous Designer that you can share with the community?**

Honestly just experiment and see what works for you best, Its all about creating a workflow that suits your needs, learn by trying and testing, cut and transform a basic starter shirt in CLO/Marvelous Designer and enjoy the journey of learning! ♡

![5783ab9f1c63423f81d7e7e1175d396a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/2983c95760f941d7a11113b5305f38ed/images/5783ab9f1c63423f81d7e7e1175d396a%E1%84%80%E1%85%B3%E1%84%85%E1%85%B5%E1%86%B74.jpg)![9e86181ea90c4d389562d2da8f1699cb](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/2983c95760f941d7a11113b5305f38ed/images/9e86181ea90c4d389562d2da8f1699cbezgif-83a731f8d738f3.jpg)

![7f8b3374980a49cc9749de5bc36e2047](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/2983c95760f941d7a11113b5305f38ed/images/7f8b3374980a49cc9749de5bc36e2047ezgif-82f1cb87a806ac.jpg)

![d26cda62305d4f2bb1929e31f4e53785](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/2983c95760f941d7a11113b5305f38ed/images/d26cda62305d4f2bb1929e31f4e53785ezgif-817f18418936ca.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/2983c95760f941d7a11113b5305f38ed/images/148553722077444cb64160621e698738Screenshot%20June%2018%202025%2011%3A35%3A10.png)
content_description: Explore the enchanting world of Dollfication, a talented fashion doll designer and student, celebrated for her pastel reinterpretation of late '90s Gyaru style, as she shares insights and inspiration from her award-winning collection.

title: Kling AI Experiment: Avatar Transitions and Realism
content:
# ✨️**Exploring _Kling AI_ for Enhanced Avatar Renders and Transitions✨️**

Hi everyone!  
In this post, I’d like to share a recent experiment where I used **Kling AI** to enhance the realism of my avatar renders and create smoother transitions between poses.

![cea42fee163a484c9257fb551def7258](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/20d2fae3d9e64e1ba1e875849b4a8483/images/cea42fee163a484c9257fb551def7258YouCut_20250612_071032878-ezgif.com-video-to-webp-converter-2.webp)

* * *

For this project, I used 3 different renders.

![d175ff247f9f46fe87280d0185da57f9](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/20d2fae3d9e64e1ba1e875849b4a8483/images/d175ff247f9f46fe87280d0185da57f951-2-1.JPG)

I used two of them — one as the starting frame and one as the ending frame — to showcase a transformation. Then, I used the **YouCut** app simply to stitch the two short video clips together, creating a seamless visual flow.

![ea2ea68c3b734cfbb16aebf5ca8a6d0c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/20d2fae3d9e64e1ba1e875849b4a8483/images/ea2ea68c3b734cfbb16aebf5ca8a6d0cScreenshot_20250612-082640_Gallery.jpg)

The results were quite promising. Kling AI added a dynamic and lifelike quality to the avatars that made the scene feel more animated and expressive.

* * *

While the results were quite promising in some cases, I also had several failed attempts. For example, in some of the test videos below, the outputs didn’t turn out well due to unclear camera angles, using only a single reference image, overly long or vague prompts, or excessive avatar motion. These factors often led to unnatural or broken animations.

![c726f1eb9a4f42f5b6823f48f3cd5b21](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/20d2fae3d9e64e1ba1e875849b4a8483/images/c726f1eb9a4f42f5b6823f48f3cd5b2120250612_060527613-ezgif.com-video-to-webp-converter.webp)![8847a312affd4c4cb8faef2939b1bd67](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/20d2fae3d9e64e1ba1e875849b4a8483/images/8847a312affd4c4cb8faef2939b1bd6720250612_061319862-ezgif.com-video-to-webp-converter.webp)![aa2b66361244460f916ecf083224f08f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/20d2fae3d9e64e1ba1e875849b4a8483/images/aa2b66361244460f916ecf083224f08f20250612_061311259-ezgif.com-video-to-webp-converter.webp)

Still, it's been a valuable learning process — and I'm excited to keep experimenting and refining the workflow!

* * *
